    Two forms of representation-finiteness agree #

    For a finite-dimensional algebra, Statement.IsRepresentationFinite (finitely generated modules, complements of submodules) agrees with the form of the ported Cartan-determinant library (finite-dimensional objects of ModuleCat, categorical indecomposability).

    Statement.IsIndecomposable A ↑M ↔ CategoryTheory.Indecomposable M
